description: This file defines an enumeration 'PdfGroupingElementTag' used for representing various structural element tags in a PDF's accessibility feature set. It includes numerous tags such as Document, Part, Article, Section, Division, etc., with some deprecated aliases, to facilitate accessibility and structure organization within PDF documents.

classes.name: PdfGroupingElementTag
classes.description: An enumeration representing different structural element tags for PDF accessibility features.
